article_title: Global nature talks reach deal but money remains an issue

tasks.prompt: What is the central message of the article?
options: Countries abandoned all biodiversity targets agreed in 2022.
Nearly 200 countries agreed a new nature action plan, but inadequate funding still threatens progress.
Private companies supplied the full $200bn needed for conservation.
Scientific disputes were the only issue discussed in Yerevan.
tasks.correct_answer: Nearly 200 countries agreed a new nature action plan, but inadequate funding still threatens progress.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מדגישה שהושגה הסכמה על תוכנית פעולה חדשה, אך המחסור במימון ממשיך לעכב את השגת יעדי הטבע.

tasks.prompt: What protection target was included in the 2022 Global Biodiversity Framework?
options: Protect every endangered species by 2027.
Restore 100% of degraded land by 2030.
End all industrial fishing within five years.
Protect 30% of the world's land and seas by the end of the decade.
tasks.correct_answer: Protect 30% of the world's land and seas by the end of the decade.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: אחד מיעדי המסגרת מ־2022 היה להכניס 30% מן היבשה והימים בעולם למסגרות הגנה עד סוף העשור.

tasks.prompt: How does the article describe the current rate of species extinction?
options: Species are becoming extinct at about 100 times the natural rate because of human activity.
Extinction has returned to its natural rate since 2022.
Only marine species are disappearing faster than normal.
The UN says no mass extinction is under way.
tasks.correct_answer: Species are becoming extinct at about 100 times the natural rate because of human activity.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי מדענים המצוטטים בכתבה, פעילות האדם גורמת להכחדה בקצב של פי מאה מהקצב הטבעי.

tasks.prompt: In the phrase “degraded land”, what does “degraded” most nearly mean?
options: Legally owned by private companies
Temporarily closed to visitors
Damaged or reduced in environmental quality
Naturally free of plants and animals
tasks.correct_answer: Damaged or reduced in environmental quality
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בהקשר של שיקום טבע, degraded מתאר קרקע שנפגעה או שאיכותה הסביבתית הידרדרה.

tasks.prompt: Why are many countries struggling to meet their nature-finance pledges?
options: They no longer accept that biodiversity is declining.
International aid has been redirected toward defence and repeated energy shocks.
Conservation organisations refuse philanthropic money.
The 2022 agreement prohibited private investment.
tasks.correct_answer: International aid has been redirected toward defence and repeated energy shocks.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מסבירה שכספי סיוע הופנו לתקציבי ביטחון ולהתמודדות עם משברי אנרגיה, ולכן קצב ההתחייבויות נמוך מהנדרש.

tasks.prompt: Why has the Cali Fund raised far less money than expected?
options: It can accept money only from governments.
It is restricted to protecting elephants and tigers.
Companies are barred from using genetic material.
Contributions are voluntary, making companies difficult to pressure.
tasks.correct_answer: Contributions are voluntary, making companies difficult to pressure.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בנט מסביר שהאופי ההתנדבותי של הקרן מקשה להפעיל לחץ על חברות הנהנות מחומר גנטי שמקורו בטבע.

tasks.prompt: Give two examples from the article showing that nature recovery is possible.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להביא שתי דוגמאות קונקרטיות מן הכתבה, כולל מין, שטח או הישג שימור.
expected_points: Countries have placed 623 million acres (252 million hectares) of degraded land under protection.
WWF highlighted recoveries of elephants, green sea turtles and tigers.
Bluefin tuna was cited as an example of nature recovering.

tasks.prompt: Explain Anna Ducros's claim that governments are “paying twice”.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר את הסתירה בין שני סוגי ההוצאה ולכלול את דוגמת הדיג התעשייתי.
expected_points: Governments spend money on nature and climate recovery.
At the same time, they subsidise industries that damage nature.
Large-scale fishing and trawling are given as a concrete example.
The harmful subsidies increase the amount later needed for restoration.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the achievements and unresolved problems at the Yerevan nature talks in 4–5 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: הסיכום צריך לכלול את ההסכם החדש, הפיגור ביעדי 2022, התקדמות אחת לפחות ושתי בעיות שנותרו.
expected_points: Nearly 200 countries agreed key parts of a new action plan after extended talks.
They acknowledged that the world is falling behind on the 2022 biodiversity targets.
Protected land and recovering species show that conservation can work.
Finance remains insufficient, including weak pledges to the Cali Fund.
Some countries also obstructed approval of scientific reports.

tasks.prompt: Write a short policy recommendation addressing the article's biggest financial obstacle to nature recovery.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציע צעד מעשי המבוסס על הכתבה, להסביר כיצד הוא יגדיל מימון או יפחית נזק, ולהתייחס להוגנות.
expected_points: Propose reducing harmful subsidies, strengthening required contributions to the Cali Fund or meeting the $30bn public-finance pledge.
Explain how the proposal would move money from damaging activities toward protection and restoration.
Recognise that biodiversity-rich countries and local communities should share benefits from commercial use of genetic resources.
